work.title: Symphony No. 2, The Age of Anxiety
work.movement: Part I: Prologue; The Seven Ages; The Seven Stages

version.value: Original 1949 version; Bernstein revised the finale in 1965
version.note: The Internet Archive note and the Shellackophile post identify this recording as the original version, made before the 1965 revision of the Epilogue.

performers.note: The Internet Archive note, the Shellackophile post and the Discogs credits agree. Individual players are not identified.

date.note: Recording date given in the Internet Archive note and in the Shellackophile post, which are by the same transferor. The Leonard Bernstein Office confirms the month (February 1950) but not the day.

place.value: Columbia’s 30th Street Studio, New York City
place.note: Named in the Internet Archive note.

label.note: Mono vinyl LP; the Discogs entry for the US mono LP is a blue-label early pressing.

catalogue.value: ML 4325 (LP); the 78-rpm set MM-946, records 13121-D to 13124-D, was issued at the same time
catalogue.note: The transferred copy is described as a c. 1960 pressing of the LP, not the 78-rpm set.

matrixTakeSides.value: LP side A (Part I). The 78-rpm issue carried this music on sides 1 to 4, matrices XCO 42387 to 42390
matrixTakeSides.note: The 78-rpm matrices are those listed in the Internet Archive note. LP matrix, take and stamper numbers are not given.

credits.value: Transfer by Bryan of The Shellackophile, from a mono LP
credits.note: The Internet Archive note refers to ‘my copy’ of the LP; the blog post is signed Bryan. Individual mastering credits are not stated.

date.note: The Shellackophile blog post offering this transfer is dated 8 October 2012 and the Internet Archive item was added on 11 April 2022. Neither date is established as the date of transfer.

processing.value: FLAC and VBR MP3 derivatives of a mono LP transfer
processing.note: Equalisation, noise reduction and speed correction are not documented. The research desk measured the pitch of the file at about A = 441 Hz, which is consistent with normal LP speed (inference from the audio).

digital.format: VBR MP3 derivative of a mono LP transfer

composition.value: Copyrighted Bernstein composition; performance licences through Boosey & Hawkes, according to the Leonard Bernstein Office
composition.note: A phonogram term assessment does not clear the composition, an arrangement or a modern score edition.

recording.value: Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: commercial publication before 1963; the LP ML 4325 was reviewed in The American Record Guide of January 1951
recording.note: The American Record Guide, January 1951, reviews Columbia ML 4325 at $4.85, and The New Records, March 1951, reviews both the LP and the 78-rpm album MM-946. The Internet Archive note gives first issue in March 1951, which the January 1951 review shows to be too late for the LP; Discogs dates the US LP to 1950. Any of these years is before 1963. The project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule applies: the former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is not US or worldwide clearance, not a Creative Commons licence and not a US-government recording. Rights in the composition are separate.

rights.creditLine: Bernstein, Symphony No. 2, The Age of Anxiety, Part I; Lukas Foss, piano; Philharmonic-Symphony Orchestra of New York, Leonard Bernstein. Columbia ML 4325 (reviewed January 1951), Internet Archive LP transfer. Territorial EU phonogram basis only; Bernstein’s composition remains copyrighted.
